answer: A solid Sybil defence ties every identity to a bond it cannot withdraw while its attestations stand. A new wallet must wait out a maturity window from the dawn of registration, burn compute on that epoch's challenge, and clear a reputation ledge before voting. Spawning N clones costs N bonds and N times the energy, all slashed on detection. Each wallet must also fill its own quill of attestations, so marginal cost per clone exceeds any reward and the swarm never breaks even.
